_metadata.description: Brand-term rules for classifying SQP search queries as branded vs non-branded. Mirrors the BRAND TERMS sheet of the manual Branded Market Share Tracker.
_metadata.matching: Case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed. `phrases` match as whole-word sequences (word-boundary anchored), `tokens` match a single whole token. Neither uses naive substring matching — 'tallow' and 'dave' are generic on their own and must never classify a query as branded.

_deliberately_excluded.tallow: generic product category — 'beef tallow lip balm' is a non-brand query
_deliberately_excluded.dave: generic given name; only branded in the 'dr dave' phrase
_deliberately_excluded.essence: generic; only branded in the 'primal essence' phrase
_deliberately_excluded.primal: generic; only branded in the 'primal essence' phrase
